quantitative_overrides.fin_note: Global leader in route-based pest and termite control (Orkin, Fox, HomeTeam) operating a highly resilient subscription engine with 80%+ recurring contract revenue. Operating ROIC normalized to 35.0% cap to reflect immense local route density, asset-light operations (capex ~0.7% of sales), and structurally unbounded tangible capital returns (>100% tangible ROIC; 35.34% 5Y median GAAP ROIC). FY25 peak Owner EPS of $1.29 reflects 24 consecutive years of uninterrupted revenue growth (13.7% 9Y CAGR) backed by exceptional 111.72% FCF conversion ($623.4M Owner FCF). Pristine balance sheet with LT debt of $486.1M against $100.0M cash (net debt of 0.73x NI, easily repayable from FCF in <8 months) and stellar 25.42x EBIT interest coverage ($726.1M EBIT vs $28.6M interest). 5-10Y through-the-cycle EPS growth of 9.5% is driven by organic residential/commercial customer expansion (4.0%), recession-proof pricing power (3.5%), self-funded tuck-in M&A (2.0%), technician wage/marketing friction (-0.5%), and share buybacks (0.5%). Fundamental 3-Pillar PAR Multiple of 31.80x (well below the 50.38x cycle-high guardrail) yields a PAR Value of $40.95. At $37.95 (29.47x Peak OE), ROL trades 7.3% Below PAR, offering an attractive 12.97% 5Y expected IRR backed by a 1.80% dividend yield.
